name: 新概念英语 第一册
subtitle: First Things First · 英语初阶
note: 按课次与语法点编排的听力磨耳素材（每课 3 句，英文 + 中文对照）。课名为公开目录信息，练习句为按该课场景与语法点编写，非教材原文；如需替换为教材原文，可在听力详情页用「✏️ 编辑」修改。

s: Excuse me, is this your seat?|对不起，这是你的座位吗？
Yes, it is. Thank you!|是的，谢谢你！
Not at all.|不客气。

lessons.g: Is this your...? 否定回答
s: Is this your pen?|这是你的钢笔吗？
No, it isn't my pen. It's my pencil.|不，不是我的钢笔，是我的铅笔。
Is this your book? Yes, it is.|这是你的书吗？是的。

lessons.g: My coat and my umbrella, please.
s: My coat and my umbrella, please.|请把我的大衣和雨伞给我。
Here is my ticket.|这是我的票。
Thank you, sir. Number five.|谢谢您，先生。五号。

lessons.g: Is this your...? 确认与否定
s: Is this your coat, sir?|先生，这是您的大衣吗？
No, it isn't. It's my suit.|不，不是。这是我的西装。
This is your umbrella and your coat.|这是您的雨伞和您的大衣。
This is Miss Sophie Dupont. She is French.|这位是索菲·杜邦小姐。她是法国人。
Nice to meet you, Sophie.|很高兴认识你，索菲。
Nice to meet you too.|我也很高兴认识你。
What make is it?|这是什么牌子的？
It's a Volvo. Is it a Swedish car?|是沃尔沃。是瑞典车吗？
Yes, it is. It's a Swedish car.|是的，是瑞典车。
Are you a teacher?|你是教师吗？
No, I'm not. I'm a nurse.|不，我不是。我是护士。
What's your job? I'm an engineer.|你做什么工作？我是工程师。
What's his job? He's a policeman.|他做什么工作？他是警察。
What's her job? She's a housewife.|她做什么工作？她是家庭主妇。
Are you a teacher? Yes, I am.|你是老师吗？是的。
Hello, Helen. How are you today?|你好，海伦。你今天怎么样？
I'm very well, thank you. And you?|我很好，谢谢。你呢？
I'm fine, thanks. Nice to see you.|我很好，谢谢。很高兴见到你。
Look at that man. He's very tall.|看那个男人。他很高。
Look at that woman. She's very thin.|看那个女人。她很瘦。
Look at those children. They're very happy.|看那些孩子。他们很开心。
Whose shirt is that? Is it your shirt?|那是谁的衬衫？是你的吗？
No, it isn't my shirt. It's Tim's.|不，不是我的衬衫。是蒂姆的。
Tim! Is this your shirt? Yes, sir.|蒂姆！这是你的衬衫吗？是的，先生。

lessons.g: 物主代词 my / your / his / her
s: Whose is this book? It's my book.|这是谁的书？是我的书。
Whose is that pen? It's her pen.|那是谁的钢笔？是她的钢笔。
Whose is this umbrella? It's his umbrella.|这是谁的雨伞？是他的雨伞。
What colour's your new dress?|你的新连衣裙是什么颜色的？
It's green. Come upstairs and see it.|是绿色的。上楼来看看吧。
That's a nice dress. It's very smart.|那条连衣裙真好看，很时髦。
What colour's your hat? It's grey.|你的帽子是什么颜色？灰色的。
What colour are your shoes? They're brown.|你的鞋是什么颜色？棕色的。
What colour's his tie? It's orange.|他的领带是什么颜色？橙色的。
Your passports, please.|请出示你们的护照。
Are you Swedish? Yes, we are.|你们是瑞典人吗？是的。
Here are our passports. Thank you.|这是我们的护照，谢谢。
Are these your cases? No, they aren't.|这些是你们的箱子吗？不，不是。
Are these your passports? Yes, they are.|这些是你们的护照吗？是的。
Are you tourists? Yes, we are.|你们是游客吗？是的。
How do you do? My name is Robert.|你好。我叫罗伯特。
How do you do? I'm pleased to meet you.|你好，很高兴认识你。
Come and meet our employees.|来见见我们的雇员吧。
What are their jobs? They're keyboard operators.|他们做什么工作？他们是打字员。
What are their jobs? They're sales reps.|他们做什么工作？他们是推销员。
What's his job? He's an engineer.|他做什么工作？他是工程师。
What's the matter, children?|孩子们，怎么了？
We're tired and thirsty, Mum.|妈妈，我们又累又渴。
Sit down here. Are you all right now?|坐这儿吧。现在好些了吗？
Look at those two men. They're very fat.|看那两个男人。他们很胖。
Look at that man and that woman. They're very thin.|看那个男人和那个女人。他们很瘦。
Look at the children. They're tired and thirsty.|看那些孩子。他们又累又渴。
Give me a book please, Jane.|简，请给我一本书。
Which book? This one?|哪一本？这本吗？
No, not that one. The red one.|不，不是那本。红色那本。

lessons.t: Give me a book please, Jane.
s: Give me some books please.|请给我几本书。
Which books? These?|哪些书？这些吗？
The ones on the shelf, please.|请给我架子上那些。
Give me some glasses please, Jane.|简，请给我几只杯子。
Which glasses? These glasses?|哪些杯子？这些吗？
No, not those. The ones on the table.|不，不是那些。桌子上的那些。

lessons.t: Give me some glasses please, Jane.
s: Give me some cups please.|请给我几只茶杯。
Which cups? The ones on the table?|哪些茶杯？桌子上的那些吗？
Yes, please. And give me a plate too.|是的。再给我一个盘子。
Mrs. Smith's kitchen is small.|史密斯太太的厨房很小。
There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.|厨房里有一台冰箱。
The refrigerator is white. It is on the right.|冰箱是白色的，在右边。
Where is the cup? It's on the table.|杯子在哪里？在桌子上。
Where is the bottle? It's near the window.|瓶子在哪里？在窗户旁边。
Where are the plates? They're in the cupboard.|盘子在哪里？在橱柜里。
Mrs. Smith's living room is large.|史密斯太太的客厅很大。
There are some magazines on the table.|桌子上有几本杂志。
The television is near the window.|电视机在窗户旁边。
Where are the books? They're on the shelf.|书在哪里？在架子上。
Where are the pictures? They're on the wall.|画在哪里？在墙上。
Where are the children? They're in the garden.|孩子们在哪里？在花园里。

lessons.g: 祈使句 What must I do?
s: Come in, Amy. Shut the door, please.|进来，艾米。请把门关上。
What must I do, Mrs. Smith?|史密斯太太，我该做什么？
Open the window and air the room.|打开窗户，给房间通通风。
What must I do? Sweep the floor.|我该做什么？扫地。
What must I do? Dust the cupboard.|我该做什么？擦柜子上的灰。
What must I do? Make the bed.|我该做什么？整理床铺。

lessons.g: 现在进行时 What's she doing?
s: Where's Sally? She's in the garden.|萨莉在哪里？她在花园里。
What's she doing? She's sitting under the tree.|她在做什么？她坐在树下。
What's Tim doing? He's climbing the tree.|蒂姆在做什么？他在爬树。
What's she doing? She's typing a letter.|她在做什么？她在打一封信。
What's he doing? He's reading a magazine.|他在做什么？他在看杂志。
What's the cat doing? It's drinking milk.|猫在做什么？它在喝牛奶。
It's a fine day. The sun is shining.|今天天气很好。阳光灿烂。
What are the children doing?|孩子们在做什么？
They're playing in the park.|他们在公园里玩。
What are the women doing? They're cooking.|女人们在做什么？她们在做饭。
What are the men doing? They're shaving.|男人们在做什么？他们在刮胡子。
What are the dogs doing? They're running.|狗在做什么？它们在跑。
This is our village. It's between two hills.|这是我们的村庄。它位于两座小山之间。
There is a river near our village.|我们村附近有一条河。
Where's the school? It's on the left.|学校在哪里？在左边。
Where's the park? It's near the river.|公园在哪里？在河边。
Where's the shop? It's next to the school.|商店在哪里？在学校旁边。
Where are the flowers? They're in the garden.|花在哪里？在花园里。
What are you going to do, George?|乔治，你打算做什么？
I'm going to make a bookcase.|我打算做一个书架。
What are you doing now? I'm painting it.|你现在在做什么？我在给它刷漆。

lessons.t: What are you going to do?
lessons.g: be going to 与现在进行
s: What are you going to do this evening?|你今晚打算做什么？
I'm going to write a letter.|我打算写一封信。
What are you doing now? I'm reading.|你现在在做什么？我在读书。
What are you going to do with that vase?|你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？
I'm going to put it on this table.|我打算把它放在这张桌子上。
Don't drop it! Be careful.|别摔了！小心点。

lessons.t: What are you going to do? I'm going to...
s: What are you going to do? I'm going to wash the dishes.|你打算做什么？我打算洗碗。
What are you going to do? I'm going to sweep the floor.|你打算做什么？我打算扫地。
What are you going to do? I'm going to clean the windows.|你打算做什么？我打算擦窗户。
Is there a bag on the table?|桌子上有个包吗？
Yes, there is. It's Penny's bag.|是的。是彭妮的包。
Is there any money in it? No, there isn't.|里面有现金吗？没有。
Is there a book on the desk? Yes, there is.|书桌上有书吗？有的。
Is there a cat under the chair? No, there isn't.|椅子下面有猫吗？没有。
Is there any milk in the bottle? Yes, there is.|瓶子里有牛奶吗？有的。
Hurry up! The bus is coming.|快点！公交车来了。
Are there any buses in the street?|街上有公交车吗？
No, there aren't. We must walk.|没有。我们必须走路。
Are there any apples in the box? Yes, there are.|箱子里有苹果吗？有的。
Are there any eggs in the fridge? No, there aren't.|冰箱里有鸡蛋吗？没有。
Is there any tea in the cup? Yes, there is.|杯里有茶吗？有的。
Can you type this letter for me, Pamela?|帕梅拉，你能帮我打这封信吗？
I'm sorry, I can't. The boss is waiting.|对不起，我不能。老板在等。
Can you come here a minute, please?|你能过来一下吗？
Can you swim? Yes, I can.|你会游泳吗？会。
Can you speak English? Yes, I can, a little.|你会说英语吗？会一点。
Can you help me? Sorry, I can't.|你能帮我吗？对不起，不能。

lessons.g: Do you like...? Do you want...?
s: Do you like coffee, Ann?|安，你喜欢咖啡吗？
Yes, I do. I like black coffee.|是的，我喜欢。我喜欢黑咖啡。
Do you want a cup of coffee? Yes, please.|你想要一杯咖啡吗？好的。
Do you like apples? Yes, I do.|你喜欢苹果吗？喜欢。
Do you want an orange? No, thank you.|你想要个橘子吗？不用了，谢谢。
Do you like biscuits? No, I don't.|你喜欢饼干吗？不喜欢。

lessons.g: He likes... but he doesn't like...
s: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?|伯德太太，今天要买点肉吗？
Yes, please. A pound of steak.|好的，请来一磅牛排。
He likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.|他喜欢牛排，但不喜欢鸡肉。

lessons.t: He likes... But he doesn't like...
s: He likes meat, but he doesn't like fish.|他喜欢肉，但不喜欢鱼。
She likes apples, but she doesn't like oranges.|她喜欢苹果，但不喜欢橘子。
They like tea, but they don't like coffee.|他们喜欢茶，但不喜欢咖啡。
Where do you come from? I come from Greece.|你从哪里来？我来自希腊。
What's the climate like in your country?|你们国家的气候怎么样？
It's very pleasant. It's always warm.|非常宜人。总是很温暖。
What nationality are they? They're English.|他们是哪国人？英国人。
Where do they come from? They come from England.|他们从哪里来？来自英国。
What's the climate like in England? It's mild.|英国的气候怎么样？很温和。
I'm from England. The climate here is interesting.|我来自英国。这里的气候很有意思。
What's the weather like in spring? It's often windy.|春天的天气怎么样？常常刮风。
Which season do you like best? I like summer.|你最喜欢哪个季节？我喜欢夏天。
What nationality is she? She's French.|她是哪国人？法国人。
Where does she come from? She comes from France.|她从哪里来？来自法国。
What nationality are you? I'm Chinese.|你是哪国人？我是中国人。
The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.|索耶一家住在国王街87号。
In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work.|早上，索耶先生去上班。
The children go to school in the morning.|孩子们早上去上学。
What does he usually do in the evening?|他晚上通常做什么？
He usually reads a newspaper.|他通常看报纸。
What do they usually do on Sunday? They stay at home.|他们周日通常做什么？待在家里。

lessons.g: 现在进行与一般现在对比
s: It's eight o'clock. Mr. Sawyer is having breakfast.|八点了。索耶先生正在吃早饭。
It's ten o'clock. The children are playing in the park.|十点了。孩子们正在公园里玩。
Today is an unusual day. Everyone is late.|今天是不寻常的一天。大家都迟到了。
What's the time? It's six o'clock.|几点了？六点。
What's the time? It's half past seven.|几点了？七点半。
What's the time? It's a quarter past nine.|几点了？九点一刻。
Is that all? Yes, that's all.|就这些吗？是的，就这些。
What's the time? It's five o'clock.|几点了？五点。
I must go home now. It's late.|我现在必须回家了。很晚了。
What's the time? It's twenty past eight.|几点了？八点二十。
What's the time? It's twenty-five to ten.|几点了？九点三十五。
What's the time? It's half past eleven.|几点了？十一点半。
What's the matter with him? He has a bad cold.|他怎么了？他得了重感冒。
He must stay in bed for two days.|他必须卧床两天。
He must take some medicine, too.|他还必须吃点药。
What's the matter with her? She has a headache.|她怎么了？她头痛。
What must she do? She must take an aspirin.|她该怎么办？她必须吃一片阿司匹林。
What's the matter with the children? They have a cough.|孩子们怎么了？他们咳嗽。
How's Jimmy today? He's better, thank you.|吉米今天怎么样？好多了，谢谢。
You mustn't smoke, Jimmy. You must keep warm.|吉米，你不能抽烟。你必须保暖。
Thank you, doctor. I'll follow your advice.|谢谢医生。我会听您的建议。
Don't eat too much. You mustn't eat sweets.|别吃太多。你不能吃糖。
Don't stay up late. You must go to bed early.|别熬夜。你必须早睡。
Don't be late again. You mustn't forget your book.|别再迟到。你不能忘记带书。
What's the time? It's half past eight.|几点了？八点半。
You must go to bed, Jimmy. I'm not a baby.|你该睡觉了，吉米。我不是小孩子了。
Do your homework first, then you can watch TV.|先做作业，然后才能看电视。
What's the time? It's a quarter to seven.|几点了？六点三刻。
It's time to get up. It's time for school.|该起床了。该上学了。
What's the time? It's ten to nine. Hurry up!|几点了？九点差十分。快点！
What are you going to do this weekend?|这个周末你打算做什么？
We're going to stay at home on Saturday.|我们周六打算待在家里。
On Sunday we're going to visit our friends.|周日我们打算去看朋友。
What's the time? It's twenty past four.|几点了？四点二十。
What time does the film begin? At six o'clock.|电影几点开始？六点。
What time do you have lunch? At half past twelve.|你几点吃午饭？十二点半。
There is a car race near our town every year.|我们镇附近每年都有一场汽车赛。
In 1995, there was a very big race.|1995年有一场很大的比赛。
When were they there? They were there last year.|他们什么时候在那里的？去年。

lessons.zh: 他们什么时候在那里的？
s: When were you there? I was there in 1998.|你什么时候在那里的？1998年。
When was he in Japan? He was there last month.|他什么时候在日本？上个月。
When were they at school? They were there yesterday.|他们什么时候在学校？昨天。
When did you see him? I saw him last night.|你什么时候见到他的？昨晚。
He's awful! He never says hello.|他讨厌透了！他从不打招呼。
When did she come? She came at nine o'clock.|她什么时候来的？九点。
When did you go to London? I went last week.|你什么时候去伦敦的？上周。
When did you meet her? I met her in May.|你什么时候遇见她的？五月。
When did they arrive? They arrived at six.|他们什么时候到的？六点。
Where's King Street, please?|请问国王街在哪里？
Go along this street and turn right.|沿着这条街走，然后右转。
Then you can see King Street on your left.|然后你就能看到国王街在你左边。
What did you do yesterday? I went to the shops.|你昨天做了什么？我去商店了。
What did he do last Sunday? He visited his aunt.|他上周日做了什么？他去看姑姑了。
What did they do in the morning? They cleaned the house.|他们早上做了什么？他们打扫了房子。
When did you buy those shoes?|你什么时候买的那双鞋？
I bought them last month in Paris.|我上个月在巴黎买的。
They're beautiful, but they're uncomfortable.|它们很漂亮，但穿着不舒服。
When did you write the letter? I wrote it yesterday.|你什么时候写的信？昨天写的。
When did you have breakfast? I had it at seven.|你什么时候吃早饭的？七点。
When did you finish your work? I finished it last night.|你什么时候完成工作的？昨晚。
I have a terrible toothache.|我牙疼得厉害。
When did it start? Two days ago.|什么时候开始的？两天前。
Please make an appointment with the dentist.|请和牙医预约一下。
When did you see the doctor? I saw him last week.|你什么时候看的医生？上周。
When did you take the medicine? I took it this morning.|你什么时候吃的药？今天早上。
When did you go to the dentist? I went yesterday.|你什么时候去看的牙医？昨天。
I must go to the shops. I need some things.|我必须去商店。我需要买些东西。
Here's my shopping list. Make a list too.|这是我的购物单。你也列一份吧。
I must buy some meat and vegetables.|我必须买些肉和蔬菜。
I must go to the butcher's. I need some meat.|我必须去肉店。我需要买点肉。
I must go to the grocer's. I need some sugar.|我必须去杂货店。我需要买糖。
I must go to the post office. I need some stamps.|我必须去邮局。我需要买邮票。
What did you have for lunch?|你午饭吃了什么？
I had roast beef and potatoes.|我吃了烤牛肉和土豆。
Did you have any vegetables? Yes, I had some peas.|你吃蔬菜了吗？吃了，我吃了些豌豆。
I had a cup of tea and a biscuit this morning.|今天早上我喝了一杯茶，吃了一块饼干。
I had a lovely holiday last summer.|去年夏天我度过了一个愉快的假期。
I had a good time at the party.|在聚会上我玩得很开心。
Where are you going for your holiday?|你打算去哪度假？
We're going to Paris, but we haven't had a holiday for years.|我们要去巴黎，不过我们好几年没度假了。
Have you had your holidays yet? Yes, we have.|你们休假了吗？休了。
Have you had your lunch yet? Yes, I have.|你吃过午饭了吗？吃过了。
Have you had your dinner? Not yet.|你吃过晚饭了吗？还没有。
Have you had a good holiday? Yes, we have.|你们假期过得好吗？很好。
Have you ever been to Paris? Yes, I have.|你去过巴黎吗？去过。
I went there in the spring. It was beautiful.|我春天去的。那里很美。
What have you done today? I've been very busy.|你今天做了什么？我一直很忙。
What have you done this morning?|你今天上午做了什么？
I've cleaned the house and washed the clothes.|我打扫了房子，洗了衣服。
What have you done? I've finished my homework.|你做了什么？我完成了作业。
There was a car crash near here yesterday.|昨天这附近发生了一起车祸。
Have you heard about it yet? Yes, I have.|你听说那件事了吗？听说了。
Was anyone hurt? No, they were lucky.|有人受伤吗？没有，他们很幸运。
Have you finished your homework yet? Not yet.|你作业做完了吗？还没有。
Have you seen that film yet? Yes, I have.|你看过那部电影了吗？看过了。
Have you written to him yet? No, I haven't.|你给他写信了吗？还没有。
That house is for sale. Have you seen it yet?|那栋房子在出售。你看过了吗？
Yes, I have. I saw it last week.|是的，看过了。我上周看的。
It's very nice, but it's too expensive.|房子很好，但太贵了。
Have you had your breakfast yet? Yes, I have.|你吃早饭了吗？吃了。
Have you read this book yet? No, not yet.|你读过这本书吗？还没有。
Have you met my brother yet? Yes, I have.|你见过我哥哥了吗？见过了。
Poor Ian! He's very unhappy.|可怜的伊恩！他很不开心。
When will he come back? He'll come back tomorrow.|他什么时候回来？明天。
When will you see him? I'll see him next week.|你什么时候见他？下周。
When will you go to Beijing? I'll go next month.|你什么时候去北京？下个月。
When will she arrive? She'll arrive at nine.|她什么时候到？九点。
When will they finish? They'll finish on Friday.|他们什么时候完成？周五。
Our new neighbour is a pilot. His name is Nigel.|我们的新邻居是飞行员。他叫奈杰尔。
When did you go to New York? I went there last year.|你什么时候去的纽约？去年。
When will you go to New York? I'll go next month.|你什么时候去纽约？下个月。

lessons.t: When did you/will you go to...?
s: When did you go to Spain? I went there in June.|你什么时候去的西班牙？六月。
When will you go to Spain? I'll go in July.|你什么时候去西班牙？七月。
When did they go to Japan? They went last year.|他们什么时候去的日本？去年。
Tickets, please.|请出示车票。
Here you are. What's the exact time, please?|给你。请问现在准确时间是几点？
It's half past four by my watch.|我的表是四点半。
What's the exact time? It's three minutes past six.|准确时间是几点？六点零三分。
My watch is slow. What's the exact time?|我的表慢了。准确时间是几点？
The train leaves at twenty-five past eight.|火车八点二十五分发车。

lessons.g: Whose is it? 与 have got
s: Whose is this small blue case?|这个蓝色小箱子是谁的？
Do you have any idea? It isn't mine.|你知道吗？不是我的。
Let's look inside. There's a name and address.|我们看看里面。有个名字和地址。

lessons.t: Whose is it? Do you have any...?
s: Whose is this umbrella? Is it yours?|这伞是谁的？是你的吗？
No, it isn't mine. I don't have any umbrella.|不，不是我的。我没有伞。
Do you have any matches? Yes, I have some.|你有火柴吗？有，我有一些。
Ow! That hurts! Be careful.|哎哟！好疼！小心点。
He says that he has a bad headache.|他说他头痛得厉害。
She says that she doesn't like coffee.|她说她不喜欢咖啡。
He says that he is very tired.|他说他很累。
She says that she will come tomorrow.|她说她明天会来。
They say that the film is very good.|他们说那部电影很好看。
I've got a card from Jimmy.|我收到吉米的一张明信片。
He says that he's having a wonderful time.|他说他玩得很开心。
He says that he'll be back next week.|他说他下周回来。
He says that he can't come today.|他说他今天来不了。
She says that she has finished her work.|她说她已完成工作。
They say that they want to help us.|他们说他们想帮我们。
How was the French test? It was very easy.|法语考试怎么样？很简单。
But the last question was too difficult.|但最后一题太难了。
I didn't have enough time to finish it.|我没有足够的时间做完。
This box is too heavy for me to carry.|这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
This one is very light. It's easy to carry.|这个很轻。很容易搬。
Do you have enough money to buy it?|你有足够的钱买它吗？
I want you to type this letter again.|我要你把这封信重打一遍。
It's full of mistakes.|它全是错误。
Tell him to be more careful next time.|告诉他下次细心一点。

lessons.t: I want you to... Tell him to...
s: I want him to come at six o'clock.|我要他六点来。
Tell her to bring her book tomorrow.|告诉她明天把书带来。
Tell them to wait outside, please.|请让他们在外面等。
This hat is too small for me.|这顶帽子对我来说太小了。
How do they compare? This one is bigger.|它们相比怎么样？这个更大。
Is that one the biggest? No, this one is.|那个是最大的吗？不，这个是。
Which is taller, Tom or Tim? Tom is.|汤姆和蒂姆谁更高？汤姆。
Is this book more interesting than that one?|这本书比那本更有趣吗？
Yes, it's the most interesting book I have.|是的，它是我最有趣的一本书。
That's a good idea. Let's do it.|那是个好主意。我们做吧。
This is the most beautiful dress in the shop.|这是店里最漂亮的裙子。
It's the best one, but it's the most expensive.|它是最好的，但也是最贵的。
He is the tallest boy in his class.|他是班里最高的男孩。
This is the best film of the year.|这是今年最好的电影。
She has the most beautiful voice.|她有最动听的嗓音。
This is the most expensive model in the shop.|这是店里最贵的型号。
How do they compare? This one is cheaper.|它们相比如何？这个更便宜。
It's the cheapest, but it's also the smallest.|它最便宜，但也最小。
Which is more expensive, this one or that one?|这个和那个哪个更贵？
That one is more expensive than this one.|那个比这个贵。
But this one is the most practical.|但这个最实用。
Have you got any small change?|你有零钱吗？
I've got none. I've got some, but not much.|我没有。我有一些，但不多。
I've got some coins in my pocket.|我口袋里有几枚硬币。

lessons.t: I've got none. I've got some.
s: Have you got any brothers? I've got none.|你有兄弟吗？没有。
Have you got any sisters? I've got two.|你有姐妹吗？有两个。
Have you got any milk? I've got some.|你有牛奶吗？有一些。
Knock, knock! Who's there?|咚咚！谁呀？
Nobody's at home. Everybody is out.|没人在家。大家都出去了。
Somebody is knocking at the door.|有人在敲门。

lessons.zh: 每一个、没有、任何和一些
s: Everybody likes the new teacher.|大家都喜欢这位新老师。
There is nothing in the box.|盒子里什么都没有。
Is there anything in your bag? Yes, something.|你包里有东西吗？有一点。
What were you doing at eight this morning?|今天早上八点你在做什么？
I was having breakfast when the phone rang.|电话响时我正在吃早饭。
While I was eating, Tommy was playing.|我吃饭的时候，汤米在玩。
What were you doing when I called you?|我给你打电话时你在做什么？
I was watching TV.|我在看电视。
While she was cooking, he was reading.|她做饭的时候，他在看书。
It had already happened when I arrived.|我到的时候，事情已经发生了。
When I got to the station, the train had left.|我到车站时，火车已经开走了。
He had finished his homework before dinner.|晚饭前他已经做完了作业。

lessons.t: It had already happened when I...
s: When I arrived, they had already gone.|我到的时候，他们已经走了。
When I called, she had already left.|我打电话时，她已经走了。
When we got there, the film had already begun.|我们到那时，电影已经开始了。

lessons.g: 定语从句 who / which / that
s: The man in a hat is my uncle.|戴帽子的那个男人是我叔叔。
The book which I bought yesterday is very good.|我昨天买的那本书很好看。
The girl who is singing is my sister.|正在唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。
This is the house that Jack built.|这就是杰克盖的房子。
The man whom you met is my teacher.|你见到的那个人是我的老师。
The film which we saw was boring.|我们看的那部电影很无聊。
I'm going on a trip to Australia.|我要去澳大利亚旅行。
The city which I want to visit is Sydney.|我想去的城市是悉尼。
The friend who will meet me lives there.|要接我的朋友住在那里。
The pen that I lost was a present.|我丢的那支笔是件礼物。
The woman whom we saw is a doctor.|我们见到的那个女人是医生。
The bag which she bought is very expensive.|她买的那个包很贵。
I have to go now. It's late.|我得走了。太晚了。
Do you have to work tomorrow? Yes, I do.|你明天必须工作吗？是的。
She has to look after her mother.|她不得不照顾她妈妈。
I have to get up early every day.|我每天必须早起。
He has to wear a uniform at work.|他上班必须穿制服。
Do we have to wait here? Yes, you do.|我们必须在这里等吗？是的。

lessons.g: He can't be... He must be...
s: She can't be a teacher. She must be an actress.|她不可能是老师。她一定是演员。
He must be very rich. Look at his car.|他一定很有钱。看他的车。
That can't be true. It must be a mistake.|那不可能是真的。一定是弄错了。

lessons.t: He can't be... He must be...
s: He must be at least forty.|他至少有四十岁。
She can't be tired. She just got up.|她不可能累。她刚起床。
They must be at home now.|他们现在一定在家。
He was driving at seventy miles an hour.|他当时以每小时七十英里的速度行驶。
He must have been in a hurry.|他当时一定很赶时间。
He can't have been careful. That's the problem.|他当时不可能很小心。问题就在这儿。

lessons.t: He can't have been... He must have been...
s: He must have been very tired last night.|他昨晚一定很累。
She can't have been at home. I called twice.|她当时不可能在家。我打了两次电话。
They must have been surprised by the news.|他们一定被这个消息惊到了。

lessons.g: He may be... / I'm not sure
s: Don't be so sure! He may be right.|别那么肯定！他可能是对的。
I'm not sure, but he may have been ill.|我不确定，他可能是生病了。
She may be waiting for us outside.|她可能在外面等我们。

lessons.t: He may be... He may have been...
s: He may be a doctor, I'm not sure.|他可能是医生，我不确定。
She may have been late because of the rain.|她可能是因为下雨才迟到的。
They may not come today.|他们今天可能不来。
Have you heard the sensational news?|你听到那条轰动的新闻了吗？
He said that he had passed the exam.|他说他通过了考试。
He told me that he would leave tomorrow.|他告诉我他明天就走。
He said that he was very busy.|他说他很忙。
She told me that she had seen the film.|她告诉我她看过那部电影。
They said that they were leaving soon.|他们说他们很快就走。
Have you heard the latest report?|你听到最新报道了吗？
He said that the weather would be fine.|他说天气会很好。
He told me that the train had already left.|他告诉我火车已经开走了。
He said that he had lost his keys.|他说他丢了钥匙。
She told me that she was feeling better.|她告诉我她感觉好些了。
He said that he would call me later.|他说他稍后给我打电话。
If you have a dream, work for it.|如果你有梦想，就为它努力。
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.|如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
If I had more time, I would travel.|如果我有更多时间，我就去旅行。
If you are tired, go to bed early.|如果你累了，就早点睡。
If it is fine tomorrow, we will go out.|如果明天天气好，我们就出去。
If you don't hurry, you will be late.|如果你不快一点，就会迟到。
Is that you, John? Yes, it's me.|是你吗，约翰？是的，是我。
He wants to know if you are free tomorrow.|他想知道你们明天是否有空。
He wants to know when we will arrive.|他想知道我们什么时候到。

lessons.zh: 他想知道是否/为什么/什么/什么时候
s: He wants to know why you are late.|他想知道你为何迟到。
She wants to know what you are doing.|她想知道的你在做什么。
They want to know where you live.|他们想知道你住在哪里。

lessons.zh: 萨莉第一次乘火车旅行
s: Sally took her first train ride last week.|萨莉上周第一次坐火车。
Someone invited Sally to a party.|有人邀请萨莉参加聚会。
Sally was invited to a party by a friend.|萨莉被一位朋友邀请参加聚会。

lessons.t: Someone invited Sally to a party.
lessons.zh: 有人邀请萨莉参加聚会。
s: Someone cleaned the room yesterday.|昨天有人打扫了房间。
The room was cleaned yesterday.|房间昨天被打扫了。
Someone stole my bike last night.|昨晚有人偷了我的自行车。
We went for a walk through the woods.|我们穿过树林去散步。
He hasn't been served yet.|还没有人招待他。
He will be served soon.|很快就会有人招待他。
The letter hasn't been sent yet.|信还没有寄出。
The work will be finished tomorrow.|这项工作明天会完成。
The new school will be opened next month.|新学校下个月会启用。
